items.headline: Flood Warning issued November 20 at 6:10PM EST until November 21 at 8:00AM EST by NWS Melbourne FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Urban and small stream flooding caused by excessive rainfall
is occurring.

* WHERE...Northern Brevard County in east central Florida...
Eastern Volusia County in east central Florida...

* WHEN...Until 800 AM EST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. Some roads are
impassable or closed.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 607 PM EST, emergency management reported flooding in the
warned area. While heavy rain has ended, flooding will be slow to
recede tonight.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Daytona Beach, Port Orange, Titusville, Ormond Beach, Rockledge,
New Smyrna Beach, Edgewater, Cocoa, South Daytona, Holly Hill,
Cocoa Beach, Satellite Beach, Cape Canaveral, Oak Hill,
Scottsmoor, Mims, Haulover Canal, Titusville Airport and
Playalinda Beach.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
items.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 20 at 2:52PM EST until November 21 at 1:00PM EST by NWS Melbourne FL
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Gale Warning, east winds 20 to 30 knots with
gusts up to 35 knots and seas 8 to 13 feet. For the Small
Craft Advisory, seas 6 to 8 feet expected.

* WHERE...Flagler Beach to Volusia-Brevard County Line 0-20 nm.

* WHEN...For the Gale Warning, until 4 AM EST Saturday. For the
Small Craft Advisory, from 4 AM to 1 PM EST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
